name: Tristan
source:
A veteran knight that has lived through many a battle. He specializes in wielding the longsword and bow, and he treats any perceived enemy with what might be called ruthlessness. He is the longest-serving among the Knights of the Round Table, and he is highly unimpressed with this upstart peasant girl trying to be a king.

"You hardly know the first thing about me, just as I barely know you."

[From in-game profile]
